sections.title: Payer operations & intelligence
sections.description: Membership, networks, clinical data and plan economics. Software and services—not additional insurance markets.

categories.title: Enrollment & membership
categories.description: Maintains eligibility and enrollment records, benefit elections and member changes after a plan is selected.
categories.buyer: Health plans, employers and benefits administrators

categories.title: Member billing & experience
categories.description: Connects premium collection, benefit accounts, member portals and ongoing communications. Premium billing and HSA/FSA administration are distinct functions.
categories.buyer: Health plans and employer benefits teams

categories.title: Credentialing & provider data
categories.description: Verifies credentials and maintains provider rosters, directory records, enrollment status and supporting documents.
categories.buyer: Payer networks, medical groups and credentialing teams

categories.title: Network design & adequacy
categories.description: Evaluates provider access, network composition, directory accuracy, contracting options and network performance.
categories.buyer: Health-plan network and contracting teams

categories.title: Clinical data & interoperability
categories.description: Moves and normalizes clinical information between systems. This is broader than claims clearing and is not a replacement for an EHR.
categories.buyer: Payers, providers, health IT vendors and data teams

categories.title: Actuarial & plan economics
categories.description: Models medical costs, benefit designs, pricing, risk and financial performance. Advisory and analytical tools do not themselves supply insurance coverage.
categories.buyer: Payer finance, actuarial teams, employers and risk-bearing providers

categories.title: Quality, engagement & reporting
categories.description: Measures care quality and member experience, identifies gaps in care and supports quality reporting. Quality measurement is separate from payment risk adjustment.
categories.buyer: Payer quality, population-health and compliance teams

categories.title: Payment recovery & coordination
categories.description: Finds incorrect payments and overlapping coverage, identifies the responsible payer and supports recoveries. Products differ across audits, subrogation and coordination of benefits.
categories.buyer: Health-plan payment integrity and recovery teams

categories.title: VBC contracts & settlement
categories.description: Supports patient attribution, contract modeling, performance analysis and financial reconciliation for value-based arrangements. Capabilities vary by product and contract.
categories.buyer: Risk-bearing providers, ACOs and payer contracting teams

sections.title: Care delivery organizations
sections.description: Selected operators by setting. Care delivery, physician support and ownership are not interchangeable; local services and insurance participation vary.

categories.title: Hospitals & integrated systems
categories.description: Provides hospital-based care and related outpatient services through a health-system network.
categories.buyer: Patients, referring clinicians, employers and payers

categories.title: Academic & referral centers
categories.role: Academic medicine and specialty referral care
categories.description: Combines clinical care with medical education and research, often serving complex specialty referrals.
categories.buyer: Patients, referring clinicians and payers

categories.title: Physician groups & enablement
categories.description: Organizes or supports medical practices, staffing and contracting. An enablement platform is not automatically the employer of every physician in its network.
categories.buyer: Physicians, health systems and payers

categories.title: Primary & urgent care
categories.description: Delivers office-based or virtual first-contact care. Appointment access, scope and contracted coverage vary by location.
categories.buyer: Patients, employers and health plans

categories.title: Ambulatory surgery
categories.role: Outpatient surgical care and facility operations
categories.description: Operates or supports ambulatory surgery centers and surgical facilities, usually with physician and health-system partnerships.
categories.buyer: Patients, surgeons, health systems and payers

categories.title: Home health & rehabilitation
categories.description: Provides skilled home health, rehabilitation or community-based support after or instead of a hospital stay. Service models differ across these organizations.
categories.buyer: Patients, families, discharge teams and payers

categories.title: Hospice & long-term support
categories.role: Hospice, palliative care and daily-living support
categories.description: Supports serious illness and ongoing care needs. Hospice eligibility and benefits are different from general personal-care or home-health services.
categories.buyer: Patients, caregivers and care coordinators

categories.title: Behavioral health delivery
categories.description: Provides therapy, psychiatry or facility-based behavioral care. The settings and intensity of care differ across organizations.
categories.buyer: Patients, employers and payers

categories.title: Laboratory & imaging services
categories.description: Performs laboratory tests, diagnostic imaging or radiology interpretation. Service providers are distinct from equipment and diagnostic-software vendors.
categories.buyer: Patients, ordering clinicians, hospitals and payers

categories.title: Kidney & complex care
categories.description: Includes dialysis operators and kidney-care management organizations. Not every kidney-care company operates dialysis facilities.
categories.buyer: Patients, nephrologists and payers

categories.title: Dental support organizations
categories.description: Supplies nonclinical support to dental practices; the support organization and the treating dentist have different roles.
categories.buyer: Dentists and affiliated practices

sections.title: Provider software · clinical systems
sections.description: Systems of record, documentation and diagnostic workflows. Products can complement an EHR without replacing it.

categories.title: Hospital & enterprise EHR
categories.description: Maintains the longitudinal patient record and supports clinical documentation, orders and workflows across hospitals and clinics.
categories.buyer: Health-system clinical, IT and executive teams

categories.title: Ambulatory EHR & practice systems
categories.description: Supports outpatient documentation, prescribing, scheduling and practice administration. Billing and patient engagement may be bundled or optional.
categories.buyer: Independent practices and physician groups

categories.title: Behavioral & community EHR
categories.description: Supports behavioral-health records, treatment plans, scheduling, reporting and associated billing workflows.
categories.buyer: Behavioral health agencies, therapists and community providers

categories.title: Home care & long-term-care EHR
categories.description: Supports documentation, care plans, visits and reimbursement workflows for home health, hospice, skilled nursing or senior living, depending on product.
categories.buyer: Home-care agencies and post-acute facilities

categories.title: Dental practice software
categories.role: Dental practice management and clinical software
categories.description: Coordinates dental charting, scheduling, imaging integrations, treatment plans, insurance and collections.
categories.buyer: Dental practices and support organizations

categories.title: Ambient documentation & clinical AI
categories.description: Turns clinical conversations into draft documentation and related workflow support. Clinicians remain responsible for reviewing clinical content.
categories.buyer: Health systems, medical groups and clinicians

categories.title: Clinical knowledge & decision support
categories.description: Provides evidence-based reference material, clinical guidance or workflow support. A reference product is not an autonomous treating clinician.
categories.buyer: Clinicians, hospitals and medical education teams

categories.title: Enterprise imaging & PACS
categories.description: Stores, displays and shares diagnostic images and supports radiology or enterprise-imaging workflows.
categories.buyer: Radiology departments and health-system IT

categories.title: Diagnostic AI & precision medicine
categories.role: Diagnostic decision support and precision medicine
categories.description: Includes imaging triage, clinical workflow AI and molecular-data tools. Intended uses, validation and regulatory status are product-specific.
categories.buyer: Specialists, laboratories and health systems

categories.title: Laboratory information systems
categories.description: Manages laboratory orders, specimens, results and interfaces with clinical systems; distinct from the laboratories performing tests.
categories.buyer: Clinical laboratories, pathology teams and hospitals

categories.title: Prescribing & medication workflows
categories.description: Supports prescription exchange, medication history, benefit information and medication-related clinical workflows.
categories.buyer: Prescribers, pharmacies and clinical IT teams

categories.title: Telehealth & remote care platforms
categories.description: Enables remote visits, communications or virtual-care programs. A technology platform and a contracted clinician network are different offerings.
categories.buyer: Health systems, practices and health plans

sections.title: Provider software & services · revenue cycle
sections.description: The provider's side of getting paid: access → documentation → claims → payment. Software platforms and outsourced operating services remain separate.

categories.title: Scheduling, intake & access
categories.description: Helps patients find care, book visits, complete intake and stay in contact with the practice before and after appointments.
categories.buyer: Patient-access and practice-management teams

categories.title: Eligibility, estimates & prior auth
categories.description: Checks benefits, prepares estimates and manages authorization requests before care. Provider-side submissions are distinct from payer-side coverage decisions.
categories.buyer: Patient-access, authorization and revenue-cycle teams

categories.title: Coding & charge capture
categories.description: Translates clinical documentation into billable codes and supports complete charge capture. Autonomous and assisted workflows vary by specialty.
categories.buyer: Coding, HIM and revenue-integrity teams

categories.title: CDI & revenue integrity
categories.description: Reviews documentation for completeness and coding support, helps clinicians clarify records and checks potential revenue or quality gaps.
categories.buyer: Clinical documentation integrity and HIM teams

categories.title: Claims & clearinghouses
categories.description: Validates and transmits claims, tracks responses and connects providers to payers. It does not make the vendor the insurance risk bearer.
categories.buyer: Billing offices, clearinghouses and provider IT

categories.title: Denials, appeals & A/R
categories.description: Identifies denial patterns, follows up on unpaid claims, manages appeal workflows and prioritizes accounts receivable.
categories.buyer: Provider billing and reimbursement teams

categories.title: Patient billing & payments
categories.description: Presents patient balances, enables digital payments and payment plans, and supports billing questions after insurance processing.
categories.buyer: Patient financial services and practice leaders

categories.title: Contracting & reimbursement analytics
categories.description: Analyzes contracted rates, reimbursement performance, underpayments and financial opportunities using claims and contract data.
categories.buyer: Managed-care contracting and provider finance teams

categories.title: RCM & practice-management platforms
categories.description: Provides connected software for billing and practice administration. Purchasing a software platform is different from outsourcing the revenue-cycle workforce.
categories.buyer: Health systems, physician groups and practices

categories.title: Outsourced RCM & operating partners
categories.description: Supplies operational staff, managed workflows and technology to run all or part of a provider's revenue cycle. Engagement scope varies.
categories.buyer: Provider CFOs and revenue-cycle executives

sections.title: Provider infrastructure & operations
sections.description: The systems that run the organization around the clinical encounter: data, capacity, people, purchasing, safety and security.

categories.title: Data, analytics & population health
categories.description: Combines clinical, operational and financial data to support population health, quality improvement and organizational performance.
categories.buyer: Provider analytics, population-health and IT teams

categories.title: Records exchange & information release
categories.description: Connects systems and handles access to medical records. Release-of-information services and integration APIs have different responsibilities.
categories.buyer: Health information management and interoperability teams

categories.title: Patient flow, beds & OR capacity
categories.description: Coordinates beds, operating rooms, infusion capacity, discharge workflows or staff resources to help organizations use capacity effectively.
categories.buyer: Hospital operations, nursing and perioperative teams

categories.title: Clinical communication & coordination
categories.description: Routes clinical messages, on-call communications and care-team coordination across roles and settings.
categories.buyer: Clinical operations and health-system IT

categories.title: Workforce, staffing & learning
categories.description: Supports staffing, scheduling, training, credentialing or workforce administration. Staffing agencies and software vendors are distinct models.
categories.buyer: HR, nursing, medical staff and workforce teams

categories.title: Supply chain, procurement & ERP
categories.description: Supports sourcing, procurement, inventory, finance and supply-chain coordination. Includes purchasing networks, software and medical-supply distribution.
categories.buyer: Hospital supply-chain, procurement and finance teams

categories.title: Quality, safety & patient experience
categories.role: Provider quality, safety and experience management
categories.description: Collects experience feedback, tracks safety events, manages risk and supports improvement and compliance workflows.
categories.buyer: Quality, safety, patient-experience and compliance teams

categories.title: Cybersecurity & clinical identity
categories.description: Protects clinical systems, identities, sensitive data and connected devices. Capabilities differ between identity software, device security and managed security services.
categories.buyer: Healthcare security, IT and clinical-engineering teams
